about: See who qualifies for the five-year Green Residence without a sponsor.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Green Residence guide. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Skilled workers: employment contract, MOHRE level 1 to 3, bachelor's degree and a salary of at least 15,000 AED a month
Freelancers and self-employed: MOHRE permit, a degree or diploma and income of at least 360,000 AED a year over the last two years
Investors and partners: proof of investment or contribution, with the needed licences and approvals
Holders can sponsor family under the approved requirements
documents: The guide page does not list documents
fees: The guide page states no fees
timing: The guide page gives no timing
channels: ICP Smart Services platform (sign in required)
